text.collaborativeCommunityInformedPlatformCo: A collaborative, community-informed platform for collecting, managing, and visualizing air quality measurement data—empowering communities, researchers, and organizations worldwide.
text.worldBreathesUnhealthyAir: of the world breathes unhealthy air
text.prematureDeathsGloballyLinkedAirPollutio: premature deaths globally linked to air pollution
text.aggregateMeasurementsMultipleSourcesOpen: Aggregate measurements from multiple sources—OpenAQ, PurpleAir, and more—into a unified, quality-controlled data repository. Real-time and historical data at your fingertips.
text.customizableOpenSourceDataManagementSyst: A customizable, open-source data management system that fosters collaboration, reduces redundancy, and enhances accessibility for global air quality efforts.
text.builtInputGlobalCommunityPracticeShared: Built with input from a global community of practice. Shared learning accelerates progress, helping overcome data management hurdles for more effective use of air quality information.
text.cleanAirCompassProjectEmergedCritical: The Clean Air COMPASS project emerged from a critical global need: effective air quality data management. Existing systems are falling short as monitoring efforts by governments, community-based organizations, and other institutions increase.
text.proprietaryCustomBuiltSolutionsCanCostly: Proprietary or custom-built solutions can be costly, opaque, and inefficient. This initiative directly addresses these pain points by offering a customizable open-source Data Management System (DMS), born from global feedback to meet expressed needs.
text.naturalResourcesDefenseCouncilNrdcOpen: Natural Resources Defense Council (NRDC), OpenAQ, and Spheros Environmental, with seed funding from the Clean Air Fund.
text.viewRealTimeAirQualityData: View real-time air quality data from monitoring devices around the world on our interactive map.
text.accessTransparentQualityControlledAirQua: Access transparent, quality-controlled air quality data to understand local pollution levels and advocate for cleaner air.
text.leverageStandardizedMultiSourceDataStudi: Leverage standardized, multi-source data for studies, with built-in QA/QC and flexible aggregation periods.
text.deployOpenSourceDmsWithoutVendor: Deploy an open-source DMS without vendor lock-in, customizable to your monitoring network and reporting needs.
text.integrateRegulatoryLowCostSensorData: Integrate regulatory and low-cost sensor data into a unified platform for policy decisions and public health alerts.
